newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian theatre critic found murdered.
newsitem.headline: Italian theatre critic found murdered.

text.p: A noted Italian theatre critic, Dante Cappelletti, was found murdered at his home in Rome on Thursday, police said.
Cappelletti, 50, was found by a neighbour at his apartment. His fully-clothed body was partly hidden under his bed.
Police said he appeared to have been strangled, possibly with a cord that had been ripped from his telephone. A post-mortem was being conducted.
Cappelletti, who was single, taught theatre studies at one of Rome's universities and was drama critic for the Rome newspaper Il Tempo.
He has written several books on the theatre and playwrights, including Russian author Anton Chekhov and Swiss dramatist Friedrich Duerrenmatt.
